verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents a first-party CSV export of all or a subset of invoices from the Dashboard, plus per-invoice PDF or receipt downloads, which covers the invoice-export part of the story. The evidence says nothing about exporting subscriptions or usage records, or about porting stored payment methods to another provider. General API access is only a building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: subscription export, usage-record export, payment-method portability or migration to another provider, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave

citations.quote: You can export all of your invoices or a subset of them as a CSV file by clicking Export on the Invoices page.
Depending on the invoice status, clicking the button downloads either a PDF of the invoice or a receipt.
